Do NOT apply a global sepia filter, global warm wash or global saturation change. The natural food and clear plastic tub retain their accepted colours and textures; do not yellow the transparent plastic or whiten the raw chicken. All edits are selective colour matching only.

stages.purpose: Food texture correction preserving color match
stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, local food texture cleanup after accepted colour grading.
IMAGE 1 (fibriki-pack-v7.png) is the LOCKED EDIT TARGET and visual master for all colours, shapes, layout and text.
IMAGE 2 (fibriki-pack-v6.png) is ONLY a reference for the accepted food SHAPES and the finer raw-chicken texture in the tub. NEVER copy its old red logo or duller paper colours.
IMAGE 3 (food-study-v5.png) is ONLY the master reference for the natural COHESIVE finely minced cooked chicken texture on the whole food ball and cut face. Copy its fine meat structure, never its black/brown background or its framing.

Change ONLY the excess graininess of the food textures in image 1. Four small local food zones are allowed: (a) the whole cooked chicken ball at left, (b) its cut half in front, (c) the tiny ball on the hen's tasting spoon, (d) all of the RAW chicken meatballs visible inside the transparent tub. Keep every food shape, edge, size, location and existing lighting the same.

Correct texture: these are cohesive finely ground CHICKEN meatballs, no rice or other grain. The cut face is a unified pale ivory cooked chicken mince with tiny irregular pores and a little natural fine unevenness, like the cross section in image 3. It must look delicious, moist but not shiny, naturally continuous, not a mosaic of separate granules. Remove the exaggerated individual white elongated rods, repetitive short white streaks, regular grains, rice-shaped flakes and embossed repeating patterns. The whole cooked ball keeps its gently browned natural surface with subtly fine pores and irregular browned spots from the photo master, not rice or flakes. The tiny ball on the spoon gets the same smooth fine chicken identity at small scale.
RAW balls in the tub stay RAW, pale pinkish beige fine chicken mince, smooth gently uneven surfaces with subtle tiny irregular pores, not cooked brown and not greasy. Remove all conspicuous pale elongated rice grains, dash marks, repeated crystalline or flake patterns from their surfaces. The tub contents stay natural chicken, not a rice dish. Do not flatten them into plastic smooth spheres; preserve minute natural fine minced texture and the existing slightly hand-formed contours.

LOCK AND PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE FROM IMAGE 1 EXACTLY: the successful lighter warm CREAM PAPER with its existing gradients/mottling, exact ORANGE NOVOferma logo colour and shape, medium warm BROWN ink in title/descriptor/curved caption, slightly muted hen palette and precise accepted hen drawing and spoon tasting pose. No global recolouring, colour wash or contrast change. No dulling or darkening of paper. Do not return to the scarlet logo of image 2. Every character, line, feather, letter and layout position stays the same. All text remains identical, sharp and untouched. Preserve the sleeve geometry, complete package silhouette, perspective, transparent tub material, plastic highlights and rims, shadows and all original alpha edges. No new elements or design revisions.

OUTPUT ONE PNG with original transparent alpha outside the full unclipped package silhouette. No backdrop, no exterior shadow, no padding change. This is texture cleanup of existing FOOD ONLY, not a new package design or new photoshoot.

Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing «ЛЮЛЯ МИНИ» package on a cream preview backdrop. Image 2 is ONLY the cream paper color and photographic paper-edge reference, the existing «КОТЛЕТЫ ПО-ДОМАШНЕМУ» package. Do not borrow its artwork, text, food, layout, shape or proportions.
Primary request: keep Image 1 essentially identical and make one narrow change: slightly brighten ONLY the empty cream paper sleeve and its paper halftones to match the gentle warm clean cream of Image 2. The target paper is a little gray/dull/darker than the family; lift its midtones by about 4–5 RGB brightness units. Aim approximately at a soft paper cream near RGB 241,226,198 in comparable midtone zones, retaining the natural subtle mottled paper texture, shading and photographic light. No strong yellow or orange shift. This is a small color grade, not a redesign or a new rendition.
Paper edge: very gently reduce the thin dark drawn contour along the outer top and sloping side edges of the paper sleeve, so the edge feels like the natural photographic paper edge in Image 2. Keep the exact existing silhouette, geometry, fold shadows and physical depth; do not shrink, reshape or blur the package.
Strict invariants: preserve the orange NOVOferma logo color (already correct, approximately RGB249,106,5) and brown headline ink color (already correct, approximately RGB102,65,19) exactly as in Image 1. Preserve every word, letter, serif, tracking, line break, font, size and location. Preserve the exact composition and all objects: existing chicken chef with white apron, its drawing style and printed fine outlines, its face and pose; the white serving platter; the left pair of food pieces; all sausages on the platter; all tiny herb/vegetable flecks; the food's shape, texture, browning and color; the pale raw sausages in the transparent tub; the plastic tub, clear rim and all reflections; all physical lighting and shadows within the package. Do not recolor any of those areas. Do not change the food or redraw the chicken. No global hue, saturation, sepia, warming, contrast or exposure change.
Output: exactly one complete isolated package, genuine transparent alpha background. Remove only the flat cream OUTSIDE the package, because it is the preview backdrop, not part of the packaging. Preserve all paper and the clear plastic tub inside the silhouette, with complete natural clean edges, no clipping and no external cast shadow or glow. Same front camera view and proportional size as Image 1, generous transparent margin, full bottom rim visible.
Exact text to preserve without any edit: NOVOferma; ЛЮЛЯ МИНИ; КУРИНЫЕ КОЛБАСКИ; С ЗЕЛЕНЬЮ И ОВОЩАМИ; МИНИ-ФОРМАТ.
